concerns.text: Task T022 defines novelty as 'minimum cosine distance... to ANY OTHER topic_cluster'. This contradicts Spec.md US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 and FR-004, which define novelty as the distance to the node's OWN cluster centroid. The task logic inverts the spec's definition, creating a semantic weakening of the 'Independence of Variables' principle (Constitution VII) by measuring divergence from peers rather than deviation from the group mean.

Tasks T016 and T024 are marked as incomplete (unchecked). These tasks are responsible for persisting the intermediate graph (T016) and final dataset (T024) to Parquet files. Without these artifacts, downstream tasks (T037, T026-T030) cannot execute on real data, violating Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and breaking the pipeline's reproducability chain.

Task T028 writes corrected p-values to `corrected_pvalues.json` but does not mandate that the final report generation (T029) must ingest and display these specific corrected values. This creates a risk that T029 could proceed using raw p-values, violating FR-006 (multiple-comparison correction) and FR-007 (associational labeling based on corrected stats).

Task T012b requires a KS test against an 'OpenAlex reference distribution' or 'theoretical power-law'. The spec (FR-001) and plan do not provide a verified reference distribution or a fallback mechanism for when the reference is unavailable. This introduces a silent drift where the task may fail or use an unverified theoretical model, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy).
